en: Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young woman and a young man posed in front of a painted city backdrop with a river and a large gothic-style church or cathedral. The woman wears a light-colored traditional dress and headscarf and carries a wicker basket with linens. The man wears a dark uniform with a cap and sword, saluting the woman. The background suggests a European cityscape but is clearly a painted set rather than an outdoor scene. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
